# Zebra Dry Plates

> Handcrafted silver gelatin dry plates, darkroom chemistry, and large-format photography tools made in Slovenia for modern analog photographers.

Zebra Dry Plates revives 19th-century dry plate photography with hand-coated glass plates, processing tanks, film holders, and workshops for photographers who value the craft of the negative.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand introduction, featured plates, and the Zebra story.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse all dry plates, chemistry, holders, and large-format tools.
- [Learn & Discover](/learn): Tutorials and guides on dry plate, wet plate, collodion, and large-format workflows.
- [About](/about): The story behind Zebra Dry Plates and our handcrafted process.
- [Workshops & Booking](/booking): Hands-on dry plate photography workshops in Slovenia.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about dry plates, ordering, and shipping.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the workshop.
